The following development error codes shall be reported when an API service is called with a wrong parameter: FLS_E_PARAM_CONFIG , FLS_- E_PARAM_ADDRESS , FLS_E_PARAM_LENGTH , FLS_E_PARAM_DATA .
The runtime error code FLS_E_BUSY shall be reported when an API service is called while the module is still busy.

The runtime error code FLS_E_VERIFY_ERASE_FAILED shall be reported when the erase verification function is enabled (by the com- pile switch FlsEraseVerificationEnabled ) and the erase verification func- tion (blankcheck) failed.

The runtime error code FLS_E_VERIFY_WRITE_FAILED shall be reported when the write verification function is enabled (by the compile switch FlsWriteVerificationEnabled ) and the write verification function (com- pare) failed.
The transient fault code FLS_E_ERASE_FAILED shall be reported when the flash erase function failed (in hardware).
The transient fault code FLS_E_WRITE_FAILED shall be reported when the flash write function failed (in hardware).
The transient fault code FLS_E_READ_FAILED shall be reported when the flash read function failed (in hardware).
The transient fault code FLS_E_COMPARE_FAILED shall be re- ported when the flash compare function failed (in hardware).
The transient fault code FLS_E_UNEXPECTED_FLASH_ID shall be reported when the expected flash ID is not matched (see [SWS_Fls_00144]).
The function Fls_Init shall set the FLS module state to MEMIF_ IDLE after having finished the FLS module initialization.
The function Fls_Init shall set the flash job result to MEMIF_ JOB_OK after having finished the FLS module initialization.
The function Fls_Erase shall copy the given parameters to FLS module internal variables and initiate an erase job.
After initiating the erase job, the function Fls_Erase shall set the FLS module status to MEMIF_BUSY.
After initiating the erase job, the function Fls_Erase shall set the job result to MEMIF_JOB_PENDING.
After initiating the erase job, the function Fls_Erase shall return with E_OK.
The function Fls_Write shall copy the given parameters to Fls module internal variables and initiate a write job.
After initiating the write job, the function Fls_Write shall set the FLS module status to MEMIF_BUSY.
After initiating the write job, the function Fls_Write shall set the job result to MEMIF_JOB_PENDING.
After initiating the write job, the function Fls_Write shall return with E_OK.
The function Fls_Cancel shall reset the FLS module's internal job processing variables (like address, length and data pointer).
The function Fls_Cancel shall set the FLS module state to MEMIF_IDLE.
The function Fls_Read shall copy the given parameters to FLS module internal variables and initiate a read job.
After initiating a read job, the function Fls_Read shall set the FLS module status to MEMIF_BUSY.
After initiating a read job, the function Fls_Read shall set the FLS module job result to MEMIF_JOB_PENDING.
After initiating a read job, the function Fls_Read shall return with E_OK.
The function Fls_Compare shall copy the given parameters to Fls module internal variables and initiate a compare job.
After initiating the compare job, the function Fls_Compare shall set the status to MEMIF_BUSY.
After initiating the compare job, the function Fls_Compare shall set the job result to MEMIF_JOB_PENDING.
After initiating the compare job, the function Fls_Compare shall return with E_OK.

After a read, erase, write or compare job has been finished, the function Fls_MainFunction shall set the FLS module's job result to MEMIF_JOB_ OK if it is currently in state MEMIF_JOB_PENDING. Otherwise, it shall leave the result unchanged.

After a read, erase, write or compare job has been finished, the function Fls_MainFunction shall set the FLS module's state to MEMIF_IDLE and call the job end notification function if configured (see [ECUC_Fls_00307]).

The FLS module shall call the callback function Fee_JobEr- rorNotification when the module has finished a job with a negative result: • Read job failed • Write job failed • Erase job failed • Compare job failed

The FLS module shall call the callback function Fee_JobEr- rorNotification when the module has canceled an ongoing job: • Read job aborted 46 of 71 Document ID 25: AUTOSAR_SWS_FlashDriver Specification of Flash Driver AUTOSAR CP R22-11 • Write job aborted • Erase job aborted • Compare job aborted
The FLS module shall call the callback function Fee_JobEr- rorNotification when the module has finished a compare job and the memory blocks differ: • Compare job finished and memory blocks differ

Definition of Feature A Feature describes an essential characteristic of a product. Features usually dif- ferentiate one product from similar products  in our context, features differentiate the individual products in a product line.

Definition of Feature Selection A Feature Selection is a set of Features that describes a specific product. A Feature Selection is always paired with a Feature Model . All dependencies and relations that are defined in the Feature Model shall be obeyed.

Definition of Feature Model A Feature Model describes the available features of a product line and their in- terrelations / interdependencies. In other words, a Feature Model describes a Product Line Model in the problem domain. For example, a car may have either a gasoline or a diesel engine, so the fea- tures Gasoline and Diesel are alternatives. A seven-…

Definition of Product Model A Product Model describes a product. A Product Model does not contain varia- tion points anymore (except for PostBuild variation points). It is derived from the Product Line Model by binding the variation points. In AUTOSAR, a Product Model is a collection of M1 artifacts that describes a particular Product . Except for PostBui…

Definition of Product Line Model A Product Line Model is similar to a Product Model , but contains variation points of all binding times. A Product Model is created out of a Product Line Model by keeping certain variations, and discarding others (i.e., binding). The only variation points that are still allowed in a Product Model are PostBuild variation poin…

Definition of Product A Product is an artifact that is the outcome of some type of process, for example a software that runs on one or more ECUs. In AUTOSAR, a Product is a collection of M0 artifacts. In our terminology, it is described by a Product Model on M1 Level.

Definition of Product Line A Product Line is a collection of Product s that are related. A Product Line usually consists of a set of Product s that have a certain amount of common aspects and a number of aspects that differentiate the individual Products from each other. In our terminology, a Product Line is described by a Product Line Model , which in turn…

Definition of Parent Feature , Child Feature Let f be a FM- Feature which aggregates a FMFeatureDecomposition that references a FMFea- ture f 0 in the role feature . Then f is the parent feature of f 0 , and f 0 is a child feature of f .

MANDATORYFEATURE All FMFeature s referenced in the role feature from a FMFeatureDecomposition that has the category MANDATORYFEATURE shall be present in a feature selection if and only if its par- ent FMFeature is included in the feature selection.

OPTIONALFEATURE FMFeature s referenced in the role feature from a FMFeatureDecomposition that has the category OPTION- ALFEATURE may be present in a feature selection if and only if its parent FMFea- ture is included in the feature selection.

ALTERNATIVEFEATURE Exactly one of the FMFeature s referenced in the role feature from a FMFeatureDecomposition that has the category ALTERNATIVEFEATURE shall be present in a feature selection if and only if its parent FMFeature is included in the feature selection.

MULTIPLEFEATURE One or more of the FMFeature s ref- erenced in the role feature from a FMFeatureDecomposition that has the category MULTIPLEFEATURE shall be present in a feature selection if and only if its parent FMFeature is included in the feature selection.
